title: fix(gateway): deliver activity-summary updates after compaction
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Activity clients could miss recap refreshes after successful session compaction even though the stored recap was fresh. Deferred row publication inherited the compaction or scheduler work scope, which closed before the notification reached subscribers. No later push arrived during the 110-second observation.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep accepted recap notifications with the existing Gateway subscription owner: retain any admitted root, detach only the producer's async cancellation scope, and join publication before clients and the row projection close. Reject new notifications once the scheduler/connection close prelude begins. Already accepted publication does not request new admission or wait behind suspension. Existing physical-store/generation checks, prepared-row publication, coalescing, and ordering remain in place.

## User Impact

Subscribed Activity clients receive the updating and fresh recap notifications after compaction. This is release-note context for the user-visible fix. No schema, persistence, retention, SDK signature, configuration, or update migration changes are required.

## Evidence

- Real isolated Gateway and authenticated subscribed client, two synthetic turns and successful `sessions.compact`: baseline observed zero post-compaction recap pushes for **110.546 s**, despite a fresh stored recap and a live connection. Candidate delivered exactly one fresh current recap push **66 ms after its stored update time** (89.698 s after compaction), with matching text, timestamp, transcript generation, `maxSeq=9`, and coverage 4/4. Sequence order was updating → compact → current; no duplicate fresh-current notification. Both Gateways shut down cleanly.
- Compaction correctly reused the recap text. The baseline harness's new-text matcher was too strict; the unchanged raw event trace and durable watermark independently establish the defect. Candidate proof uses the corrected freshness receipt matcher.
- The regression failed on the base at expected subscriber delivery (zero sends). With the fix, all **34 subscription tests pass**, including producer closure, coalescing, accepted-work shutdown joins, rejection after close, and subscriber filtering. Final command: `pnpm test src/gateway/server-runtime-subscriptions.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` — **115.41 s wall**; new regression **3.202 s**; real-projection publication case **8.597 s**, including its **zero caller-thread SQL** assertion. The baseline cold run took **349.93 s wall**. An initial candidate run exposed a fixture-only assertion on unprojected `compactionCount`; it was corrected to the projected label.
- Existing recap event and auxiliary-work shutdown tests passed (8 tests; **12.841 s** and **20.801 s** test time respectively). The initial combined focused invocation took **532.93 s wall**, including cold compilation and the subsequently corrected fixture assertion.
- Shared-registry/import-closure and publication-budget tests: **26 passed across 7 files**, **227.11 s wall**, all with `--maxWorkers=1`: `test/scripts/runtime-process-build-graph.test.ts`, `src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply.imports.test.ts`, `src/state/openclaw-state.worker.imports.test.ts`, `src/config/sessions/session-history-read.imports.test.ts`, `src/config/sessions/session-transcript-reconcile.imports.test.ts`, `src/worker/worker.runtime-imports.test.ts`, and `src/gateway/session-event-prepared-row.test.ts`.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`: **passed**, **3,677.39 s wall** on the loaded host, including all 27 core test type graphs, lint, export scans, and repository guards.
- Madge: **0 cycles**, **85.70 s wall**. Database worker ratchet passed against pinned base `68ebe61752ed33c688800172dc160ebff2586f18`, **29.02 s wall**. Inventory **T1 895 → 895**; notification publication is SQL-free, while recap-generation transcript reads remain with their existing owner.
- Independent Codex P2 autoreview, pinned merge base and private temporary directory: **scoped-clean, no actionable P0–P2 findings**.
- Production LOC: **+9 / −1 / net +8**. Added `OPENCLAW_*` names: **0**. Exact-head CI [run 37220922537](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37220922537) passed with no failed jobs: **407 s** elapsed; changed-test shard durations were **79–151 s** (including setup and cleanup). Per-test CI timing was not extracted.

Separate existing session-snapshot/transcript cancellation warnings remain in the synthetic workload; the activity-summary publication warnings are gone. This PR is scoped to recap notification ownership.

## Overlap

Adjacent work includes #164989 (recap transcript reads) and #164922 (session lifecycle transactions), plus the sessauthtail, nativepatchtail, and delegateexec lanes. #162433 is the broad ownership-design umbrella. These changes keep minimal notification-owner hunks and do not restructure those lanes.


## Released SDK surface check

Compared the production diff and latest release tag `v2026.9.8`, and checked `src/plugin-sdk/**`, `src/plugins/runtime`, and documented plugin subpaths. This PR changes no production function signature, sync/async contract, callback shape, or export. `startGatewayEventSubscriptions` remains internal; the changed `Start` callback type exists only in test support. No compatibility record or SDK type test is required.
